description:
Draft a brand kit from a company website: reads its colors, fonts and logo and returns a draft with a confidence and a source for each field.

Use this tool when: the user gives a website and wants charts in that brand and has no saved kit yet.
Behavior: by default nothing is saved (save is false) and you only get a draft. Each extraction that finds something uses one of the plan's small monthly website-extraction allowance; blocked, failed or empty lookups are not counted. save: true stores the kit on the account and counts toward the plan's kit limit, so confirm with the user before you save. Private and internal addresses are refused (400 url_not_allowed); other failures are 422.

Returns: the draft in readable form (name, slug, palette, background, text and grid colors, font, logo) with confidence and source where the API gave them, and whether it was saved.
Errors (the message is plain text and keeps the API's details): 400 — invalid spec; every failing field is listed with its path. 401 — API key missing or invalid. 402 — monthly allowance used up; do NOT retry, tell the user (the message has the reset date and an upgrade link). 403 — the plan does not include something you used (pdf, a size above the plan cap, a brand kit over the limit); do NOT retry the same request, tell the user. 404 — unknown brand slug (the message lists the available ones). 429 — rate-limited; wait for Retry-After. Network error — chart-output.com is unreachable or timed out. For 402 the metric is url_extractions.

save.description: true stores the kit on the account. Default false (draft only). Ask the user first.

slug.description: Slug to use if the kit is saved: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.

name: create_brand_kit_from_url
